text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
—Sudden bad news arrived from home. Tamamo 
Cross's mother had collapsed from illness.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Although no serious harm was done, Tamamo 
Cross lost her focus over the incident and 
got caught in a fall during a mock race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though the injury was nothing more than a 
bruise— she developed a fear of racing in 
the high-speed pack.
